label: 靶场 LV2 · 中世纪长弓与火绳枪训练场
designIntent: preserve the established shooting-range courtyard identity while advancing from an ancient range to a medieval military training compound
use exactly one continuous gabled roof shared by the rear armory and the front firing line
combine longbow and early matchlock training in one readable organized facility
add ordered ammunition, powder and arrow supply groups around the yard without blocking circulation
retain the stable 2x2 logical footprint and change only the authored visual model
structure: exactly one rear stone-and-timber armory hall and front firing line under one continuous gabled roof
exactly one square roofless crenellated stone watchtower accepted from structure V02 as the LV2 level marker
one low crenellated boundary with a centered front entrance
one four-post firing line supporting the same main roof, with two benches and a clear center aisle
exactly three detailed round straw targets on the target line
one attached organized rack containing longbows and matchlocks
exactly six ordered ammunition crates in two side supply groups, with two powder kegs and two arrow bundles
all components remain inside the original 2x2 foundation
negativeConstraints: no second tower, tower roof, second hall, detached hut or expanded courtyard
no modern concrete bunker, chain-link fence, vehicle, radar or electric target carrier
no soldiers, hamsters, loose weapons, readable text, neon or sci-fi machinery
